# Publishing schedule — 6-week proposal

<!-- GENERATED by tool/publish/build_kit.py (tool/publish/schedule.py): edit schedule.py, not this file -->

> **PROPOSAL — needs the owner's approval. Nothing is published, uploaded or scheduled by us.**
> **Unreviewed-science rule:** every video is EXPERT_REVIEW_PENDING. The owner decides when (and whether) to publish, after the expert review and the other gates below. Weeks are relative: week 1 starts when the owner approves the first topic. A slot whose topic has an open gate is skipped and the next ready topic moves up.

Status below = state of the rendered files when this file was generated (2026-10-26).

## 1. Cadence

Two topic slots per week. Each slot publishes one topic in three language editions: three YouTube videos (UZ, RU, EN: separate videos, separate playlists, same English narration, subtitles in the edition's language) and three Instagram Reels (the 9:16 files).

| Slot | Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | YouTube UZ + RU + EN | Reel UZ | Reel RU + Reel EN | | | | |
| B | | | | YouTube UZ + RU + EN | Reel UZ | Reel RU | Reel EN |

Time of day: the owner decides after looking at the channel's own analytics (none exist yet; we make no assumption about the audience's time zone).

Lower-intensity option: one slot per week (the 12 topics then take 12 weeks); or one language edition per platform first (UZ), the others a week later. Optional: the vertical file can also go to YouTube Shorts (check the platform's current length limit first: NEEDS_OWNER_CHECK).

## 4. Ad-readiness checklist

Use before any paid promotion (and before the first organic post). `OK` = verified in the repository; `OPEN` = needs a person; `NEEDS_OWNER_CHECK` = we have not read the platform's current rules.

| Area | Item | Status | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rights | Music | **OK** | None used in any video (storyboards, QA notes). |
| Rights | Voice | **OK (licence) — listening review OPEN** | Synthetic: Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0, voice af_heart, via kokoro-onnx (MIT); no attribution required, credited anyway. `docs/video/tts/VOICE_DECISION.md`. Residual risk noted there: provenance of Kokoro's synthetic training audio. |
| Rights | Fonts | **OK** | Inter and Instrument Serif, SIL OFL (`assets/fonts/*-OFL.txt`). |
| Rights | Imagery | **OK** | Original schematics and drawings by LabGuide plus real app screens; no third-party photograph, stock footage, micrograph or logo (`docs/SCHEMATICS_PROVENANCE.md`, each video's CLAIMS_AND_EVIDENCE.md §2). |
| Rights | Logo | **OK — owner to confirm** | Owner's app icon (`assets/images/logo_mark_large.png`). |
| Rights | Render tool licence (Remotion) | **OPEN — blocker (G4)** | Free for individuals, non-profits and for-profit companies of up to 3 people; a larger company needs a Company licence. The owner checks the company size (`video_studio/node_modules/remotion/LICENSE.md`). |
| Quality | Listening review of the English synthetic voice | **OPEN — blocker (G2)** | Nobody has listened to it yet. Do not call it natural or professional. |
| Quality | Expert science review | **OPEN — blocker (G1)** | Every video is EXPERT_REVIEW_PENDING. Rows tagged NEEDS_EXPERT in each CLAIMS_AND_EVIDENCE.md go to a laboratory specialist (calibration: E2, E7, E9; leukocyte: E7, E10, E11). |
| Quality | Native RU / UZ review (subtitles, on-screen text, this kit's RU/UZ texts) | **OPEN — blocker (G3)** | All RU/UZ wording is NEEDS_NATIVE_REVIEW (`docs/L10N_TERMINOLOGY_DECISIONS.md`). |
| Quality | Honest audience expectation about language | **Info** | All editions have English narration; RU/UZ editions are subtitled. No Russian or Uzbek voice exists that is both good and cleared for commercial use (`VOICE_DECISION.md`). Say so in the first pinned comment (already in the kit). |
| Quality | Disclosures on screen and in text | **OK** | On screen: illustrative-data badge, schematic badge (QA.md). In text: illustrative data, educational use, synthetic English narration (Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0), expert review pending — in every description and caption (checked by `tool/publish/test_kit.py`). |
| Product truth | App availability and store approval status | **OPEN — blocker (G5)** | The free version is, per `docs/PAID_BRANCH_STATUS.md`, in store review; this kit knows no public store link, so every link is a placeholder. Owner confirms the approval status and fills the links. |
| Product truth | Video matches the advertised build | **OPEN — owner check** | Frames were rendered from the free app (`fix/images-apparatus@215d3e8`); the video says nothing about price or tiers. Confirm the advertised build behaves the same. |
| Product truth | Paid features (Student/Teacher/Specialist Pro, Premium) | **OPEN — blocker for paid topics (GP)** | Not live: flags off, nothing deployed, store products unconfirmed, no real sandbox purchase run, device attestation for the 7-day trial not written (`docs/PAID_BRANCH_STATUS.md`, D-77/D-78). Paid-topic videos stay unpublished until the owner confirms the paid build is live. |
| Platform | Health / medical advertising policy of each platform | **OPEN — NEEDS_OWNER_CHECK** | Not read by us. The videos make no diagnosis, treatment, accuracy or time-saved claim. |
| Platform | Synthetic / altered-content disclosure setting | **OPEN — NEEDS_OWNER_CHECK** | Answer the platform's own question honestly; the text already states the voice is synthetic. |
| Platform | Format limits (length, safe zones) | **OPEN — NEEDS_OWNER_CHECK** | Videos run about 1.5–2 minutes. Vertical subtitles were kept inside x 70–1010 and above y 1640 (QA.md); check on the real app UI before paid promotion. |
| Platform | Landing page and privacy-policy URL live | **OPEN — NEEDS_OWNER_CHECK** | The app links `https://labguide.nfcstore.uz/privacy/`; whether the site is live is the owner's to confirm. |
| Text | No price, product id, discount or availability date | **OK** | Enforced by the lint in `tool/publish/test_kit.py`. |

### Remaining blockers (summary)

1. Listening review of the English synthetic voice (G2).
2. Expert science review of each topic (G1).
3. Native RU and UZ review of subtitles, on-screen text and the RU/UZ kit texts (G3).
4. Remotion licence company-size check (G4).
5. App availability and store approval status; the store links (G5).
6. Paid features not live: paid topics (`exam_simulation`, `teacher_pro`, `premium_overview`) cannot be published until the paid build is live (GP).
7. Platform rules (health ads, synthetic-voice setting, format limits) and a live landing/privacy page: owner checks.
